Kitchen Kylo

STAR WARS INSPIRED KITCHEN// ROLE: 3D ARTIST// THEME: IMPERIAL INTERIORS + LIGHTING

From a warm reference kitchen to an imperial one.

A Star Wars inspired kitchen with imperial style interiors and lighting. There is no concept art for this one, only a reference image of an ordinary sunlit kitchen, which I restyled as a dark, panelled imperial interior.

Scroll down to see the drafts, the wireframe and a few close-ups.
